title: OpenAI · 博客来源更新
summary: 博客内容与 changelog 同步，新增 Ultrafast 模式、sandbox 计费、12小时缓存等公告。

added_lines: Added Ultrafast mode to the Agents API. Set agent.service_tier to ultrafast with a supported model to reduce the time between generated tokens.
OpenAI-hosted sandbox compute is now billed during active turns. You no longer pay for idle time between turns.
OpenAI-hosted sandboxes in the Agents API now include the Artifact SDK and skills for creating and editing spreadsheets, presentations, and Word documents.

You can now choose 12-hour prompt caching in the API. 12-hour prompt caching keeps shared instructions, tools, and context cached longer to benefit from lower cached-input pricing, even when requests are hours apart. 12-hour cache writes cost 2.5x the input token price. Read more here.

You can now pre-warm an OpenAI-hosted sandbox before attaching it to an Agents API session. Prewarming improves latency by creating and configuring the sandbox before a user finishes sending their message. This means the user doesn't have to wait for all this work to complete.
